scripts.app:restart: fuser -k 3100/tcp 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; cd apps/app && npx next build && npx next start -p 3100
scripts.oracle:restart: fuser -k 38174/tcp 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; cd apps/oracle && npx tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start: fuser -k 3100/tcp 38174/tcp 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; concurrently "cd apps/oracle && npx tsx src/index.ts" "cd apps/app && npx next build && npx next start -p 3100"
